verifications.note: 大江网/德兴融媒体中心 groundbreaking report: '工程始于乐平分输站，途经德兴分输站，止于婺源分输站，管道全长97公里，设计年输气量2.8亿立方米...项目总投资约3.8亿元' — states the Leping-Dexing-Wuyuan branch runs from Leping distribution station via Dexing distribution station to Wuyuan distribution station, total pipeline length 97 km, matching the recorded value exactly.

resolutions.researcher_notes: MISSING_REF unit. Two independent sources found and verified, both naming the Leping-Dexing-Wuyuan branch explicitly and both stating the pipeline length as 97 km: (1) tt.m.jxnews.com.cn (大江网/Jiangxi Daily group, Dexing municipal media center groundbreaking report, 2020-12-10) and (2) yingdodo.com (an independent construction-project database listing, 2018-05-25, predating the news article — an independent origin, not a republication). Both agree exactly with the recorded LengthKnown=97.00 km. Note: yingdodo's entry is dated 2018 (pre-construction planning figure) while the news article is 2020 (at groundbreaking) — both cite the same 97 km design length, so no discrepancy despite the different dates. class_out=REFS_ADDED, same recorded value kept, tier high (2+ independent sources agreeing).
